newsitem.title: USA: ILC Technology to buy back stock.
newsitem.headline: ILC Technology to buy back stock.

text.p: ILC Technology Inc said Tuesday directors had authorized the company to repurchase up to one million shares of its 4.8 million common shares outstanding.
Purchases will be made on the open market from time to time over the next two years, the company said. Any shares repurchased will be retired.

It said share repurchases will be funded from existing cash, internally generated funds or through short-term debt. ILC also said directors amended its shareholder rights plan, extending its expiration date to December 31, 2006.
The original plan was scheduled to expire in 1999, spokesman Ronald Fredianelli said.
The amendments also change the exercise price under the plan to $55 from $15 per share and reduce the stock-ownership level at which rights become exercisable.

Also changed was the level of stock ownership that triggers the plan, cutting it to 15 percent -- from 20 percent -- of the outstanding shares acquired or sought by any person or group, the company said.
The amendments are intended to bring the plan more in line with the current provisions of shareholders' rights plans of many other companies, ILC explained.
